name: Taiji of Crystal Strategems: South->East transition, may rest to deal 3 damage to opponent's champion
notes: South->East is adjacent (IsAdjacentDirection: SOUTH<->EAST/WEST, GameLogic.php:19859-19867), so this reuses the same Fel Eidolon Inherited 'adjacent direction on Spell activation' trigger mechanism as hydroguard-retainer-north-west-draw (Subcards lineage patch + activate Tera Sight), just starting from SOUTH and answering 'EAST'. The transition callback ($shiftingCurrentsTransitions['SOUTH->EAST']['l17uc67eaq'], GameLogic.php ~20630-20636) requires the card to be awake (Status==2, seeded via patchMzId) and queues a YES/NO 'rest to deal 3 damage?' decision; answering YES rests Taiji (Status -> 1) and deals 3 unconditional damage to the opponent's champion via DealChampionDamage.

rulesClauses: Whenever your Shifting Currents changes from South to East, you may rest CARDNAME. If you do, deal 3 damage to target champion you don't control.
